In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''[[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]]''' commanded a cargo vessel belonging to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. However, after the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] attacked the convoy in a [[Raid on an Imperial cargo convoy|raid]], he attempted to halt the [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] storming the bridge of his ship, but was overwhelmed.
